exposure: Gestational age at index cesarean delivery (32+0 to 36+6 weeks and <32+0 weeks)
outcome: Appearance, pulse, grimace, activity, and respiration (APGAR) score <7 at 5 minutes
cohort: Women in the Swedish Medical Birth Register between 1983 and 2016 with 1 previous preterm index cesarean delivery (n=9300) or 1 previous term index cesarean delivery (n=57,168) and a subsequent trial of labor after cesarean delivery
finding: Previous preterm cesarean delivery was not associated with an increased risk of uterine rupture in women undergoing trial of labor after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women with a prior preterm Cesarean delivery were not at increased risk for uterine rupture during a trial of labor after Cesarean (TOLAC) compared to women with a prior term Cesarean delivery.
